title: "Markdown that stays safe" description: Raw HTML and javascript links are neutralized by default. tags: [security]

Sitefile's Markdown renderer has no dependencies and supports the parts you use every day: headings, emphasis, strong, strike, code, lists, quotes, code blocks, links and images.

Content is data, not code.

Raw HTML such as <script>alert(1)</script> is shown as text, and a javascript: link loses its link.

  1. Write posts in Markdown
  2. Run sitefile build examples/blog
  3. Deploy dist/
